description: T-3490: three legacy-formula shapes (stored without the dynamic-array flag) holding a spill reference. A1 =SEQUENCE(3) spills A1:A3; B1:B3 hold 10, 20, 30. C2 and C5 hold the legacy =SIN(A1#)+B1:B3 (a spill reference mixed with a plain range), D2 and D5 the legacy bare =A1#, E2 and E5 the legacy scalar host =SUM(A1#)+B1:B3, on and off the spill's rows. F:H read FORMULATEXT (whether Excel adds an @), I:K ISBLANK of the cell below (whether the formula spills).
